visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with black hair in long braids wears an elaborate Chinese God of Wealth costume, featuring a large gold and red headpiece with red pom-poms and a white fur collar. She is positioned in front of a dark wooden lattice wall adorned with numerous red honeycomb paper fans and a gold-on-red Chinese banner. She has a pouting, sad facial expression with her eyes cast slightly downward. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot where the character holds open a large, empty brown leather wallet, looking disappointed. A lion dance head with white fur and large eyes pops up from behind her. She then transitions to holding a red folding fan and several red envelopes, her expression shifting to one of mock surprise. (3) A close-up shows the female looking startled with wide eyes as she holds the empty wallet again. The lion dance head continues to move energetically in the background. In the next segment, she holds a red plastic money-spraying gun labeled with white text and a red fan. Artificial banknotes are seen flying in the air around her as she poses. (4) The final phase features a close-up where the character leans her chin on her hand, resting against a large golden ingot (Yuanbao) prop. A digital distortion filter is applied to her face, greatly enlarging her mouth and eyes for a comical effect. The background remains consistent with the red festive decorations.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A dark wooden paneled room decorated for Chinese New Year with red paper fans, a central gold-on-red banner, and various traditional props like golden ingots.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat begins. A young female voice speaks with a bright, fast-paced delivery. (2) A series of high-pitched 'Ding' sound effects repeat in sync with the rhythm, marking visual transitions. The voice modulates pitch to emphasize comedic points. (3) The BGM remains consistent in tempo while the voice adopts a more playful and slightly exaggerated tone. Short, crisp digital pips occur as accents. (4) The audio ends with a slightly distorted vocal effect accompanying a humorous concluding phrase, while the background music fades with a sharp cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by satirizing the common Chinese New Year experience where mothers 'store' children's red envelope money, using a festive God of Wealth aesthetic and meme-style editing.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: A Supreme branded money gun is used as a prop, but not as a central advertisement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-contrast festive colors and rapid jump cuts synchronized with digital sound effects to maintain high viewer engagement.
